svg.title: Q-RAG Agent diagram
svg.desc: Inventory and construction: the figure contains a Q-RAG Agent frame with state and action embedder blocks, green embedding connections, a Q-value block, a policy symbol, context document cards c0-c5 with dashed upward pointers, a current state expression on the left, an action/document result on the right, and an Environment frame with critic, question/answer boxes, next-state expression, and feedback arrows. Confirmed SAM picture assets cover only the five small q/c icon tiles: P002 left q, P005 left c4, P001 lower next-state q, P004 lower next-state c3, and P003 lower next-state c4; all are constructed first and then independently referenced for replacement at original source_crop positions. Symmetry basis: the main agent and environment are horizontally organized flow sections; document cards are near-equipartitioned left-to-right under the agent; feedback arrows close the loop around the figure.
